_comment: Provenance for vendored schemas. The schema files are byte-identical to upstream so the weekly canary can compare hashes; nothing may be edited into them.

schemas.name: SARIF 2.1.0 JSON Schema
schemas.why: check --format sarif output is validated against it in tests. Vendored rather than fetched so the suite stays offline: a network fetch turns an unrelated outage into a red build, and offline CI is what this project exists to provide.
